root_cause: reconcileInit re-read every key a live increment touched during a scan and let the stored count replace the live one. The DM watcher's incrementDirectMessage never stores the message, so the startup DM scan dropped DMs arriving during it, a confirm recount for one peer re-read and dropped other peers' live bumps, and the startup scan set counts without the confirm recount's counted-id record.
fix: The DM slice merges additively: per scanned key, the stored count is combined with the pre-scan count (max, or pre + stored ids not yet counted when a counted-id record exists) plus live bumps during the scan; no re-read, keys outside the scan untouched; a read/clear during the scan drops that key's pre and stored part (per-slice guard). The startup scan reads last-read per key, records the stored ids it counted (kept unchanged on a failed read) and re-bases in-flight confirm recounts; the confirm recount settles its count and record inside the serialized commit. A late held write schedules a deduping recount instead of a live bump. Module and behaviour-doc wording corrected.

tests_added.kinds: Real-store scans and recounts: live DM during the startup scan; other peer kept through a recount; scan between recounts; pre > stored; read and clear during a scan; cross-slice scan during a DM scan; read before the scan's read; late held write during a scan; stored + live-only + late write around a scan (two orderings); failed scan and recount reads; scan queued behind a blocked recount. Each remediation test confirmed failing without its fix.

mutation.tool: stryker concurrency 1, scratch config (unreadStore.ts reconcile, DM scan and recount regions; unreadStore.test.ts only)

Mostly outside this change and covered by other suites not in this run's include (shared re-read loop, initInProgress/slice literals, the boundary and case filters copied into the scan), map-cleanup deletion guards, unreachable fallbacks (`?? []`, the !committed branch that runs only when the import fails), and the late handler's id/last-read guards, which duplicate the dedupe the scheduled recount already does.

e2e.result: non-relay 72 passed; relay 353 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped; no INVALID marker; no stall-probe report.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: unreadStore has three writers of the DM count (live bump, startup scan, confirm recount) plus late held writes, with no single written model of which message set each counts; each Codex round found the next interleaving. A per-peer ledger of counted message ids, shared by all writers, would have been the simpler design from the start.
retrospective.surprised_by: The module comment claimed every increment source persists first, which was false for DMs since the watcher was written; and the vitest same-tick dynamic-import mock race recurred and made a scan look like it read nothing.
